title: India High-Altitude Defence Technology Ecosystem Atlas
subtitle: R&D, operational adaptation, testing, indigenous capability and emerging industrial opportunities
scope_note: The Atlas maps the documented high-altitude defence technology ecosystem. It does not assume a formal High Altitude Defence Corridor exists.

evidence_policy.rule: A means the source directly documents the stated claim. It does NOT mean deployed, mature, indigenous, procured or commercially successful.
Use for leads where a primary source is not yet available. Do not publish as hard fact without corroboration.
Research lead only; requires primary-source verification.
Analytical inference/opportunity hypothesis; never present as source-documented fact.

claim_notes.research_need: Listed by DRDO or another primary source as a research or technology need — not an existing product or fielded capability.
claim_notes.technology_transfer_available: Listed as a DRDO technology available for transfer — availability, not commercial production or procurement.
claim_notes.demonstrated_demand_or_event: Documented Army/industry demonstration or stated demand — not a procurement or induction.
claim_notes.research_thrust: Declared research thrust of an academic or DRDO centre.
claim_notes.policy_or_industrial_ecosystem: Policy instrument or regional industrial ecosystem — an enabler, not a capability.
claim_notes.development_programme: Documented development programme — not yet evidence of production or induction.
claim_notes.documented_operational_or_institutional_: Documented operational infrastructure or institutional capability.
claim_notes.innovation_pipeline: Innovation pipeline or cohort (e.g. Inno-Yoddha) — ideas and prototypes, not procurement.

categories.definition: Energy generation, storage, thermal management and remote power
